name: fulcrum
description: Fulcrum agent control plane — task tracking, memory, and agent run lifecycle
_migratedTo_comment: Scaffolding for PR 14.5. Populate with a fully-qualified new repo URL when migrating Fulcrum's Gemini extension to a different upstream. Per docs/extensions/releasing.md, `gemini extensions update` redirects installed instances to the new source.

settings.name: FULCRUM_MEMORY_V3
settings.description: Enable Fulcrum memory v3 (tiered L0/L1/L2). Default off until rollout is complete.

settings.name: FULCRUM_MONITOR_PORT
settings.description: TCP port for the Fulcrum HTTP monitor (dashboard + read-only JSON API). Default 4721.

settings.name: FULCRUM_NO_MONITOR
settings.description: Set to 1 to suppress the HTTP monitor (CI or when port 4721 is taken).
